definitions.explanation: A lamp or light fixture installed along streets and roads to illuminate public areas at night.

examples.japanese: {街灯|がいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{照|て}らしている→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: The streetlights illuminate the dark road.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{街灯|がいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧。
examples.english: This street has few streetlights, so it's scary at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{街灯|がいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧LED⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The old streetlights were replaced with LEDs, making the town brighter.

notes:
A compound of {街|がい} (street, town) and {灯|とう} (light, lamp).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街灯|がいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{灯|とも}る→灯る：13381_tomoru⟧: the streetlights come on
- {街灯|がいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: under a streetlight
- {街灯|がいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: the glow of a streetlight
- {街灯|がいとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: there are few streetlights

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {街路灯|がいろとう}: street lamp — the official term used by local governments; {街灯|がいとう} is the everyday word

COUNTER: {本|ほん} or {基|き}
